{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count the number of unique patients
num_patients = len(deduplicated_data)
print(num_patients)"}
